sahneler.metin: An oil well off Australia began leaking uncontrollably.
Within hours, oil and gas spread across the sea, later catching fire.
The well had been temporarily suspended.
Its cement barrier at the bottom had failed.
Pressure-containing caps that should have been installed were not.
The leak continued for more than two months.
The regulator had relied on the operator's assurances.
Australia then created a new offshore safety regulator.

aciklama:
Montara leaked oil and gas into the Timor Sea for weeks. The cause: failed cement at the casing shoe plus missing pressure barriers in a suspended well.
